title: Lululemon founder stuns Canadian women’s leadership conference with sexist comments
summary_full: Chip Wilson said men importing brides from Thailand was due to women waiting too long to have childrenThe controversial founder of Lululemon suggested women in Canada are having too few children and this could lead some men to bring in brides from Thailand, in remarks that stunned audience members at a women’s leadership conference.Chip Wilson, who built the Vancouver yoga-wear startup into a global athleisure empire, was a featured speaker at the Leadership Forum in Calgary earlier this week, an event organized by Axis Connects to advance women in leadership. The organization says it aims to create space for “candid conversations about the barriers women face both in business and society”. Continue reading...
